title: List the cancelled orders
prompt: For every cancelled order, return first_name (the customer's), order_id (the order's id) and status. Sort by order_id.
hints: Which column of orders holds the id of a customer?
Join orders to customers on that column, then keep the cancelled orders.
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'

wrongAnswers.misconception: Matches the order's id with the customer's id.
Returns the orders of every status.

feedback: Pick one cancelled order in schema.sql, find its customer_id, and check that your result shows that customer.
